Produce on full training down, preserve through E015 skipped actor1 down, consume only unlocked training up1. Actor0 stays original. Use an eighth transient shared continuation workspace buffer, not an unaccounted per-board resident allocation.

actual_removable_work.producer: Existing actor1 down still computes ordered +0 positive-part sum. Cache the same normalized positive-part division, or separate1/na in uniform case, while original child reach remains pr/na. Never divide child reach by pr. Produce even when own reach is0.
actual_removable_work.consumer: For unlocked actor1 up, remove the first positive-part accumulation loop and its rc fill, and remove upward sigma recomputation. Load cached sigma in original action order for out and strategy update; retain child-CFV order, old-regret read and r>0 discount plus r*d update. For common small arities the existing rc register slots can hold cached sigma instead; generic may reread cache.
actual_removable_work.not_removed: Old regret reads/discount arithmetic, child CFV loads, value accumulation, regret/strategy writes, actor0 work, locks, other kernels and launch count. Two textual sigma expressions are not proof of two hardware divisions; common NA2/3/4 compiled code already reuses normalized registers within up.

lifecycle: Ordinary eager/profiled/captured pair: full p0 down writes cache1; up0 changes only player0 learning state; p1 down nh1=0 leaves cache1 intact; up1 consumes it. Each next full first down refreshes. No cross-iteration validity reuse or new graph variant.
Capture is not execution. Warm first-capture must retain ordered g0 then g1 launch; cache pointers allocated before capture and fixed for its lifetime.

Standalone/continuation sweep is already full for either p. A p1 standalone therefore produces before use even after new roots or workspace swap; p0 may write unused cache but never consume it. Do not infer validity from p==1 alone.
Evaluation down uses strategy sums: pass explicit write-disabled control; eval-up remains unchanged. Following ordinary/generic training performs a full producer before consume.

Locked nodes retain existing lock_sigma paths and never read cached slots; unlocking/relocking drains and recreates graphs, then full producer refreshes. Error retry must not rely on scratch validity; no claim of recoverability after partial updates.

Cache has no CPU/save serialization, projection or orbit transport. Symmetric continuation projects/transports learning arrays after a sweep; next full down regenerates cache from those current arrays.

Paged/stored take/swap/absorb/length checks/poisoning/drains must include the new eighth mutable buffer. Parked StoragePlan can be compact while GPU traversal is full: size and index cache from finalized GpuSolver arena_elements/node_data_off only.
exactness_contract: Preserve positive-part ternary, +0 initializer, ascending sum/child/update order, sum>1e-12 threshold and division operands.
Keep down uniform child reach pr/na verbatim; cache uniform sigma separately as1/na, including zero or subnormal parent reach.

Keep original multiply/add expressions and NVRTC options; a global f32 store/load must preserve the producer sigma bits. Source argument alone does not prove compiler FMA/unrolling/dependency equivalence.
Cache storage must not alias regret/strategy/reach/CFV buffers. Parent old-regret block remains unchanged until its own up1 update; action blocks are disjoint.
No cache hit/miss policy, arity variant, optional allocation fallback, accuracy change or actor0 cache is proposed.
